description: Owner 2026-11-27 (issue #23): Tactical Mastery is adapted for a game without stances (each rank starts combat with 5 rage, 25 at 5/5) and Anger Management (requires Tactical Mastery 5/5) gives 2 rage at the start of each own turn; both become learnable. Companion talent lines are unchanged.

edits.name: Tactical Mastery and Anger Management become available
Tactical Mastery: starting rage
edits.new:
h.parryBase = ARMS_PROTO.deflectionPerRank * (alloc.deflection || 0); h.sweepCharges = 0; h.sweepTurns = 0;
    if (alloc.tactical > 0 && h.maxRage) h.rage = Math.min(h.maxRage, (Number(h.rage) || 0) + ARMS_PROTO.tacticalRage * alloc.tactical);

edits.name: Anger Management: rage each own turn
edits.new:
if (u.proto && u.sweepTurns > 0 && --u.sweepTurns === 0) u.sweepCharges = 0;
    if (u.proto && u.tal && u.tal.anger > 0) gainRage(u, ARMS_PROTO.angerRage, 'anger');
